name: How much does it typically cost to remodel a rental property?

mainEntity.name: How much does it typically cost to remodel a rental property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rental remodel costs depend heavily on the existing condition, scope of work, and chosen materials. Cosmetic turnovers—such as drywall patching, baseboard replacement, and interior painting—cost significantly less than full structural rehabs or complete kitchen and bathroom gut renovations. When updating a rental, choosing standard, hard-wearing materials over high-end custom finishes helps keep overall costs manageable. HH Remodeling works directly with landlords to define project scopes, offering fair pricing by handling carpentry, drywall, tile, and paint with our in-house crew while coordinating plumbing and electrical sub-trades.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary by project scope, ranging from economical cosmetic refreshes like paint and drywall repair to complete kitchen and bath overhauls using durable finishes.
